requirements.title: The gate and the nested module
requirements.rationale: A zoekt dependency is only worth carrying if measured search_files use justifies it, and it must stay confined to a module that embedders opt into.

criteria.condition: the measured figures on the navigation baseline plus at least two target repositories of 5 000 files or more show search_files below 25% of read-phase tool calls and fewer than one third of search_files results truncated or retried within two turns in the same directory, or any check in Requirement 9 fails
criteria.action: merge no code of this spec and close the PRD with the measured numbers recorded in it, without changing the thresholds
criteria.contract: No codesearch/ file, tools seam change or documentation change from this spec is merged; the PRD records the figures, the repositories and the date

setup: the recorded measurement figures: search_files share of read-phase calls, truncated-or-retried share, repository count and sizes
check.pseudocode: assert gate(share=0.30,trunc=0.1,repos=[5000,6000],r9=true)=='go'; assert gate(0.2,0.3,[5000,6000],true)=='nogo'; assert gate(0.3,0.1,[5000,6000],false)=='nogo'

criteria.action: begin with the measured go/no-go figures, the repositories measured and the measurement date
criteria.contract: the first content is the measured figures, the repositories and a date; it records module path and packages for builder, parser and searcher, memory vs file search, byte-offset symbol fields, search options, go list -m all and four-target build/vet results; it describes the opt-in with Options.Index and the allowlist entry, known differences from search_files, and that goldens are tied to the zoekt version

setup: codesearch/README.md
check.pseudocode: t=read('codesearch/README.md'); assert firstSection(t) contains figures,repos,date; for k in required_topics: assert k in t

criteria.action: be the nested module github.com/agentfox/agentkit-go/codesearch with `replace github.com/agentfox/agentkit-go => ..`, a pinned zoekt release, a go.mod header comment stating the boundary rule as difftest/go.mod does, and the files index.go, search.go, tool.go and policy_test.go
criteria.contract: the module path is github.com/agentfox/agentkit-go/codesearch; a replace maps github.com/agentfox/agentkit-go to ..; zoekt is required at an exact release version; the header comment states the boundary rule like difftest/go.mod; index.go, search.go, tool.go and policy_test.go exist

setup: the repository working tree
check.pseudocode: f=modfile.Parse('codesearch/go.mod'); assert f.Module.Path=='github.com/agentfox/agentkit-go/codesearch'; assert replace('github.com/agentfox/agentkit-go')=='..'; assert requires zoekt with semver tag; for n in files: assert exists

criteria.action: keep go.mod, go.sum and internal/policy unedited, keep allowedModules unchanged, and keep `go list -deps ./...` in the root free of any module not present before this spec
criteria.contract: go.mod, go.sum and internal/policy have no diff; go list -deps ./... names no zoekt module or any module absent before the spec; allowedModules is unchanged; the policy tests pass

setup: the root go.mod, go.sum and internal/policy from before the spec
check.pseudocode: assert gitdiff(['go.mod','go.sum','internal/policy'])==''; deps=run('go list -deps ./...'); assert no 'sourcegraph/zoekt' in deps; assert run('go test ./internal/policy').ok

criteria.condition: codesearch.New is called with a non-nil *tools.Workspace
criteria.action: return a tools.Index without starting a goroutine, running a process, walking the workspace or touching the disk
criteria.contract: Returns (tools.Index, nil); no goroutine count change, no child process and no file created

setup: a temp workspace with files
a TempDir pointing at an empty temp directory
a fake Runner that records invocations
a counting wrapper around the walk
check.pseudocode: g=NumGoroutine(); idx,err=New(ws,opts); assert err==nil && idx!=nil; assert NumGoroutine()<=g; assert calls==0; assert len(ReadDir(tmp))==0; assert builds(idx)==0

criteria.condition: codesearch.New is called with a nil workspace
criteria.action: return an error and no index
criteria.contract: Returns (nil, non-nil error)

check.pseudocode: idx,err=New(nil,Options{}); assert idx==nil; assert err!=nil

criteria.action: treat a zero or negative MaxFiles, MaxBytes, MaxBuildTime or TempDir-equivalent limit as its default (100 000 files, 1 GiB, 60 s, os.TempDir()) and treat a nil Env as tools.ReducedEnv(nil)
criteria.contract: zero and negative limits become 100000 files, 1 GiB and 60 s; TempDir becomes os.TempDir(); positive values are kept; nil Env resolves to tools.ReducedEnv(nil)

setup: Options values with zero, negative and positive MaxFiles, MaxBytes, MaxBuildTime and an empty TempDir
check.pseudocode: o=normalise(Options{MaxFiles:-1,MaxBytes:0,MaxBuildTime:-5}); assert o.MaxFiles==100000; assert o.MaxBytes==1<<30; assert o.MaxBuildTime==60*time.Second; assert o.TempDir==os.TempDir(); assert equal(o.Env,tools.ReducedEnv(nil))

requirements.title: The seam in the tools package
requirements.rationale: A standard-library interface in tools lets codesearch import tools and keeps the index a one-line opt-in.

criteria.action: export SymbolQuery{Name, Kind, Path string; Exact bool}, SymbolAnswer{Matches []SymbolMatch; FilesIndexed int}, the Index interface (Symbols, Tools, Invalidate, Close) and Options.Index, importing only the standard library and existing root packages
criteria.contract: the code compiles; the zero value of Options.Index is nil; no import outside the standard library and this module's packages appears

setup: a fake type implementing tools.Index with Symbols, Tools, Invalidate and Close
tools.SymbolQuery{Name,Kind,Path,Exact}, tools.SymbolAnswer{Matches,FilesIndexed}, tools.Options.Index
check.pseudocode: var _ tools.Index = (*fake)(nil); o:=tools.Options{Index:f}; assert tools.Options{}.Index==nil; assert onlyStdlibAndRoot(imports('./tools'))

criteria.action: export CapMarker(noun, param string, limit, max int, alternative string) string and ClampLimit(n, def, cap int) int returning exactly what the existing unexported capMarker and clampLimit return for the same arguments
criteria.contract: the strings and ints are identical for every row; at limit==max the at-the-cap form is produced

setup: a table of (noun,param,limit,max,alternative) including limit below, equal to and above max
a table of (n,def,cap) including zero, negative and above cap
check.pseudocode: for r in rows: assert CapMarker(r...)==capMarker(r...); for c in clamps: assert ClampLimit(c...)==clampLimit(c...)

criteria.condition: Options.Index is set
criteria.action: append Index.Tools() after the built-in tools and leave FileNavigationTools() unchanged
criteria.contract: The built-in tools keep their pinned order; code_search is absent from FileNavigationTools()

setup: a fake Index whose Tools returns a tool named code_search
check.pseudocode: with=All(opts+fake); base=All(opts); assert names(with)[:len(base)]==names(base); assert last(with).Name=='code_search'; assert 'code_search' not in FileNavigationTools()

criteria.condition: Options.Index is nil
criteria.action: return a tool list byte-for-byte identical to the one 02_symbol_navigation_tools pins
criteria.contract: the serialisation equals the golden exactly

setup: the pinned tool-list golden from 02_symbol_navigation_tools
check.pseudocode: assert json(All(Options{Workspace:ws}))==golden

criteria.condition: an index tool has the same name as a built-in tool
criteria.action: return an error naming the duplicate tool
criteria.contract: All returns (nil, error) whose message contains the duplicate tool name

setup: a fake Index whose Tools returns a tool named search_files
check.pseudocode: ts,err=All(opts); assert ts==nil; assert contains(err.Error(),'search_files')

criteria.condition: write_file or edit_file finishes its write attempt, whether it succeeded or failed
criteria.action: call Index.Invalidate with the slash-separated workspace-relative path before releasing the per-path lock
criteria.contract: Exactly one Invalidate(rel) call per attempt, on success and failure paths

setup: a fake Index recording Invalidate arguments and whether the per-path lock was held
a workspace with a nested file sub/dir/a.txt
check.pseudocode: run write_file(sub/dir/a.txt); assert calls==['sub/dir/a.txt']; run edit_file missing text; assert len(calls)==2 && calls[1]=='sub/dir/a.txt'; assert lockHeld all

criteria.condition: execute, run_command or powershell returns, whatever its outcome
criteria.action: call Index.Invalidate with the empty string
criteria.contract: Exactly one Invalidate("") call per invocation

setup: a fake Index recording calls
the shell tools available on the platform
check.pseudocode: for tool in shells: for cmd in [ok,fail,timeout]: n=len(calls); tool.run(cmd); assert calls[n:]==['']

criteria.action: block for no longer than it takes to set a flag even while a build or query is running, return no error, and not panic on a closed index
criteria.contract: each call returns within 100 ms while the build is still blocked; no panic occurs on the closed index; no error is surfaced (the method has no return value)

setup: a codesearch index whose build is blocked by a blocking fake Runner
a second index that has been closed
check.pseudocode: go search(); waitBlocked(); d=timeit(Invalidate('a.go')); assert d<100ms; assert buildStillBlocked(); closed.Invalidate('x') // no panic

requirements.title: code_search arguments and errors
requirements.rationale: Validation before any index work keeps a malformed call cheap and makes every failure shape predictable to the model.

criteria.action: be Builtin, parallel and read-only, take query (required string) and path, max_files, context_lines (optional), describe itself as "zoekt query syntax" and never as "RE2" with the four examples `sym:Runner`, `retry file:\.go$ -file:_test`, `lang:python "def load"` and `(compaction or summarize) case:no`, and carry the PromptGuideline "Use code_search for ranked questions about the codebase; search_files for an exhaustive regex scan."
criteria.contract: Name is code_search and it is Builtin, parallel and read-only; query is required; path, max_files and context_lines are optional; the description contains "zoekt query syntax", does not contain "RE2" and contains the four example queries; PromptGuidelines contains the exact pinned sentence

setup: the tool returned by Index.Tools()
check.pseudocode: t=idx.Tools()[0]; assert t.Builtin && t.Parallel && t.ReadOnly; assert required==['query']; assert contains(desc,'zoekt query syntax') && !contains(desc,'RE2'); for ex in four: assert ex in desc; assert guideline in t.PromptGuidelines

criteria.condition: query is empty after trimming, longer than 1 024 bytes, rejected by zoekt's parser, or context_lines is negative
criteria.action: reject the call before any index work
criteria.contract: ErrResult with code invalid_arguments; for a parser rejection the message includes the parser's message; no build is started

setup: a fresh index with a counting build hook
check.pseudocode: for args in cases: r=call(args); assert r.IsError && r.Code=='invalid_arguments'; assert contains(call('(').Message, parseErr('(').Error()); assert builds==0

criteria.action: default context_lines to 2 and clamp it to tools.MaxSearchContextLines, and default max_files to 10 and clamp it to 25 with tools.ClampLimit
criteria.contract: the default shows 2 context lines either side and 10 files; max_files 100 behaves as 25 and the marker reflects limit 25; context_lines 500 behaves as tools.MaxSearchContextLines

setup: a fixture repository with 40 matching files and wide match contexts
check.pseudocode: r=call({query}); assert len(files)==10; assert contextBefore(r)<=2; r=call({max_files:100}); assert len(files)==25; r=call({context_lines:500}); assert maxContext(r)==MaxSearchContextLines

criteria.condition: path resolves outside the workspace or does not exist
criteria.action: refuse the call before any index build
criteria.contract: ErrResult code path_not_allowed for a path outside the workspace (via Workspace.Resolve) and code read_failed for a path that does not exist; no build is started

setup: a fresh index with a counting build hook
a workspace and a sibling directory outside it
check.pseudocode: assert call({query:'x',path:'../outside'}).Code=='path_not_allowed'; assert call({query:'x',path:'nope/missing'}).Code=='read_failed'; assert builds==0

criteria.action: apply path as a conjunction with the parsed query built as query nodes, never by string concatenation: a directory becomes an anchored file: prefix on its slash-separated workspace-relative name with regexp metacharacters escaped, a file becomes the same pattern anchored to its end, and the workspace root adds no constraint, so an `or` in the query cannot return a file outside path
criteria.contract: path pkg/a returns only files under pkg/a/ and not pkg/ab/; the file path returns only that file; the root adds no constraint and returns all matching files; the metacharacter directory returns only its own files; the constraint is built as query nodes (query.NewAnd), not string concatenation

setup: a fixture with pkg/a/x.go, pkg/ab/y.go, other/z.go, and a directory named c++[1] with a file, all containing the word retry or fetch
check.pseudocode: r=call({query:'retry or fetch',path:'pkg/a'}); assert paths(r)==['pkg/a/x.go']; r=call(path:'c++[1]'); assert all(startswith(p,'c++[1]/'))

criteria.condition: the call context is cancelled
criteria.action: stop and return an aborted result
criteria.contract: ErrResult code aborted with the text "Operation aborted"

setup: a context cancelled before the call
check.pseudocode: ctx,cancel=WithCancel(); cancel(); r=tool.Run(ctx,args); assert r.Code=='aborted' && r.Text=='Operation aborted'

criteria.condition: the index build fails for a reason other than a file, byte or time bound, for example the shard directory cannot be created
criteria.action: return an index failure
criteria.contract: ErrResult code index_failed whose message includes the cause

setup: Options.TempDir naming a regular file so the shard directory cannot be created
check.pseudocode: f=touch(tmp/file); idx=New(ws,{TempDir:f}); r=call(query); assert r.Code=='index_failed'; assert contains(r.Message, 'not a directory')

criteria.condition: the search fails or a query runs longer than 10 s
criteria.action: cancel the query and return a search failure
criteria.contract: ErrResult code search_failed; for the 10 s case the message says the query timed out and should be narrowed

setup: a searcher test seam that returns an error
a searcher test seam that blocks until its context ends, with the 10 s query bound shortened through an injected clock or deadline
check.pseudocode: r=call(failing); assert r.Code=='search_failed'; r=call(blocking); assert r.Code=='search_failed' && contains(r.Message,'timed out') && contains(r.Message,'narrow'); assert searchCtx.Err()!=nil

requirements.title: code_search result shape and truncation
requirements.rationale: Ranked, file-grouped output inside the 50 KB limit with working markers is the reason the tool exists.

criteria.action: return files in zoekt's score order (a sym: hit on a declaration outranks a hit in a comment), at most max_files files, each with at most 3 chunks in zoekt's order with each chunk's lines in line order, context_lines lines either side, overlapping chunks merged and every line cut to tools.SearchLineChars
criteria.contract: the declaring file is first; at most max_files files are returned, grouped by file; a file shows at most 3 chunks, each with lines in ascending order; overlapping chunks are merged and each line is cut to SearchLineChars

setup: a fixture where one file declares func Runner and another mentions Runner only in a comment
a file with 6 separated matches
a file whose long lines exceed SearchLineChars
a fake Runner supplying symbols
check.pseudocode: r=call({query:'sym:Runner'}); assert files(r)[0]=='decl.go'; assert all(len(f.chunks)<=3); for c in chunks: assert sorted(lines); assert all(len(line)<=SearchLineChars)

criteria.action: render each file as a header followed by lines in the RenderSearchText shape (`N: matched line`, `N- context line`), the header giving the workspace-relative slash path with control characters replaced by `?`, the file's total match count, a note when matches were not shown, and, for a match on a declaration's start line, that declaration's name (Container.Name for a member) with at most 5 names
criteria.contract: matched lines print as `N: text` and context as `N- text`; the header shows the slash path with control characters replaced by `?`, the total match count and a note about matches not shown; member declarations appear as Container.Name; no more than 5 declaration names appear

setup: a match on the start line of func (Server) Run and of three more declarations
a file with a control character in its name
a file with more than 3 chunks of matches
a line match on 7 declaration start lines
check.pseudocode: assert regex('^\d+: ') for matches; assert '\x01' not in header; assert 'Server.Run' in header; assert count(names)<=5; assert contains(header,'not shown')

criteria.action: begin the text with a first line stating the number of files, the index size, the symbol sources as files per outline backend, whether ctags was unavailable, and, when they apply, the partial note and the dirty-overlay note
criteria.contract: line 1 states the number of files, the index size and files per outline backend; line 1 states whether ctags was unavailable when it was; partial and dirty-overlay notes appear only when they apply

setup: indexes in four states: complete with ctags, ctags unavailable, partial, with dirty overlay
check.pseudocode: l=firstLine(text); assert matches(l,'\d+ files'); assert contains(l,'go/ast'); assert contains(partialL,'partial'); assert !contains(cleanL,'partial')

criteria.condition: a query matches no file
criteria.action: return a successful result whose text says nothing matched and still shows the first line
criteria.contract: OKResult, not an error; Data.files is empty

setup: a built fixture index
check.pseudocode: r=call({query:'zzzznomatch'}); assert !r.IsError; assert contains(r.Text,'no match'); assert firstLine(r.Text)!=''; assert len(r.Data.files)==0

criteria.condition: more files matched than max_files
criteria.action: append tools.CapMarker("files", "max_files", limit, 25, "narrow the query or add a path") to the text and record the truncation
criteria.contract: Metadata.Truncated is TruncatedByLines; at max_files 25 the marker takes the at-the-cap form

setup: a fixture with 30 files matching the query
golden marker text tied to the pinned zoekt version
check.pseudocode: r=call({max_files:10}); assert endsWith(r.Text,CapMarker('files','max_files',10,25,alt)); assert r.Meta.Truncated==TruncatedByLines; r=call({max_files:25}); assert contains(r.Text,CapMarker('files','max_files',25,25,alt))

criteria.condition: the rendered result exceeds tools.DefaultByteLimit
criteria.action: drop whole files from the end while keeping at least one, drop that file's chunks from the end if it alone is too large, and append a bytes marker naming a narrower call using path, file: or fewer context_lines
criteria.contract: Rendered text is at most tools.DefaultByteLimit bytes; Metadata.Truncated is TruncatedByBytes

setup: a fixture where each of 25 files yields about 4 KB of text
a fixture where one file alone yields over 50 KB of chunks
check.pseudocode: r=call(big); assert len(r.Text)<=DefaultByteLimit; assert len(files)>=1; assert r.Meta.Truncated==TruncatedByBytes; assert regex('path|file:|context_lines', marker)

criteria.action: return Data carrying files (path, score, match count, chunks with line numbers and text, symbol names), truncated, note, partial, symbol_sources, ctags_available, files_indexed, dirty_files and the counts of skipped files
criteria.contract: Data has files (path, score, match count, chunks with line numbers and text, symbol names); Data has truncated, note, partial, symbol_sources, ctags_available, files_indexed, dirty_files; Data carries the skipped file counts

setup: a built index that skipped one binary and one oversized file and has one dirty file
check.pseudocode: d=r.Data; for k in ['files','truncated','note','partial','symbol_sources','ctags_available','files_indexed','dirty_files','skipped']: assert k in d; f=d.files[0]; assert keys(f)>= {path,score,matches,chunks,symbols}

criteria.action: for any query and index, produce truncation markers that each name a call the tool accepts (REQ-TOOL-09b) and a text no longer than tools.DefaultByteLimit
criteria.contract: the text is at most tools.DefaultByteLimit bytes; every marker's suggested parameters are accepted by the tool's schema and validation, so replaying the marker's call is not invalid_arguments; at the maximum limits the marker says the cap is already the maximum rather than suggesting a larger value

setup: a fixture repository large enough to trigger both caps
a fake Runner
check.pseudocode: for q,mf,cl,p in gen(): r=call(...); assert len(r.Text)<=DefaultByteLimit; for m in markers(r.Text): assert !call(parseCall(m)).Code=='invalid_arguments'

requirements.title: Building the index
requirements.rationale: The index must hold exactly the files search_files can see, with symbol data from the project's own outline, and must stay bounded on huge trees.

criteria.condition: the first code_search call reaches an index that has not been built
criteria.action: build the index lazily during that call, and never build it from New or from find_symbol
criteria.contract: The build counter is 0 after New and after any find_symbol call, and 1 after the first code_search

setup: an index with a build counter and a fixture workspace
a find_symbol tool wired with Options.Index
check.pseudocode: assert builds==0; find_symbol(...); assert builds==0; cs(); assert builds==1; cs(); assert builds==1

criteria.action: hold exactly the files tools.Walk yields from the workspace root with IncludeHidden false and Options.Ignore, restricted to regular files of at most 1 MiB with no NUL byte in the first 8 KiB, each added under its slash-separated workspace-relative name with its content and symbol sections, count the skipped files, never use zoekt's git indexer and leave CTagsPath empty so zoekt starts no ctags process
criteria.contract: the two sets are equal; the hidden directory, symlink, binary and oversized files are absent; the 1 MiB file is present; document names are slash-separated workspace-relative paths

setup: a tree with nested .gitignore files, a nested repository, a hidden directory, a symlink, a binary file with a NUL byte and a 1 MiB + 1 file
a file exactly 1 MiB
a fixture with one binary and one oversized file
a process-spawn spy and a builder-options spy
check.pseudocode:
want=filter(Walk(ws,root,{Ignore,IncludeHidden:false})); got=indexedNames(idx); assert set(got)==set(want)
build(); assert skipped.binary==1 && skipped.oversized==1; assert builderOpts.CTagsPath==''; assert spawns_from_zoekt==0; assert 'gitindex' not in deps

criteria.action: obtain symbols from outline.OutlineMany in batches of at most 100 files with outline.Options{Root: workspace root, Runner}, where Runner is Options.Runner, else nil when DisableCtags is set, else tools.CtagsRunner(Options.Env) constructed on first use, and supply the sections from whichever outline backend produced each file
criteria.contract: OutlineMany is called with batches of at most 100 files and Root equal to the workspace root; with Options.Runner set that runner is used; with DisableCtags and no Runner the outline Runner is nil; without either, tools.CtagsRunner(Options.Env) is constructed only on first use; sections come from whatever backend produced each file

setup: a workspace of 250 Go and text files
a recording fake Runner in Options.Runner
one index with DisableCtags and one with defaults
check.pseudocode: assert max(batchSizes)<=100; assert all(opts.Root==root); assert sum(batchSizes)==250; assert runnerFor(DisableCtags)==nil

criteria.condition: universal-ctags is unavailable
criteria.action: keep working, say in the first line that ctags was unavailable and that non-Go symbols are the heuristic's column-0 declarations only, and keep symbol sections for Go files from go/ast
criteria.contract: The result is successful, not an error; Data.ctags_available is false

setup: a Runner returning tools.ErrCtagsUnavailable
a Go file declaring func Runner and a Python file with a column-0 def
check.pseudocode: r=call({query:'sym:Runner'}); assert !r.IsError; assert contains(firstLine,'ctags') && contains(firstLine,'column-0'); assert r.Data.ctags_available==false; assert 'decl.go' in paths(r)

criteria.action: write shards to <TempDir>/agentkit-codesearch-<hash of root>/<run id>/ with the directory created at mode 0700, the hash being at least 64 bits of a cryptographic hash of the absolute root and the run id unique per index instance
criteria.contract: each run directory is under agentkit-codesearch-<hash of absolute root>; the hash part has at least 16 hex characters and equals a sha256 prefix of the absolute root; the two run ids differ; the directories have mode 0700 (on platforms that support it)

setup: a TempDir, two index instances over the same root
check.pseudocode: d1=runDir(i1); d2=runDir(i2); assert d1!=d2; assert parent(d1)==parent(d2); assert len(hashPart)>=16; assert mode(d1)==0700

criteria.condition: a build starts
criteria.action: remove sibling run directories of the same hash not modified for 24 hours, leave younger ones in place, and touch its own directory at most once an hour while it is queried and never another run's directory
criteria.contract: A 25-hour-old sibling is removed and a recent sibling remains

setup: sibling run directories under the same hash dir with mtime 25 hours old and 1 hour old
a directory under a different hash 25 hours old
check.pseudocode: os.Chtimes(old,-25h); build(); assert !exists(old); assert exists(recent); assert exists(otherHash); touchCount(own)<=1 per hour; mtime(recent) unchanged

criteria.condition: a build reaches 100 000 files, 1 GiB of indexed content or 60 s of wall time
criteria.action: stop the build, keep what it has indexed, answer from it, and never retry the partial index on later calls
criteria.contract: Data.partial is true with partial_reason files, bytes or time, and a note tells the model to narrow path or use search_files; only the dirty-threshold rebuild replaces a partial index

setup: scaled-down MaxFiles, MaxBytes and MaxBuildTime options on a fixture bigger than each
a blocking fake Runner for the time case
a build counter
check.pseudocode: for b in [files,bytes,time]: r=call(); assert r.Data.partial && r.Data.partial_reason==b; assert contains(r.Data.note,'search_files'); call(); assert builds==1; assert elapsed<deadline+slack

criteria.condition: the call context is cancelled during a build
criteria.action: discard the partial build and leave the next call free to build again
criteria.contract: The call returns code aborted; the next code_search starts a new build

setup: a blocking fake Runner that the test releases later
a build counter
check.pseudocode: go cancelAfterBlocked(); r=call(ctx); assert r.Code=='aborted'; release(); r2=call(); assert !r2.IsError && !r2.Data.partial; assert builds==2

requirements.title: Freshness
requirements.rationale: A search result that shows content older than the model's own last write is worse than no index.

criteria.condition: Invalidate(rel) is called with a non-empty rel
criteria.action: record rel as dirty and, at query time, remove every dirty path from the indexed results, so a deleted file appears in no result
criteria.contract: After edit_file of a line, code_search returns the new line and not the old one

setup: a built index over a fixture
edit_file, write_file and tools.All wired to the index
check.pseudocode: edit_file(a.go,'oldToken','newToken'); assert 'newToken' in text(cs('newToken')) && 'oldToken' not in text(cs('oldToken')); write_file(new.go,'freshWord'); assert 'new.go' in paths(cs('freshWord'))

criteria.condition: Invalidate("") has been called and a query arrives
criteria.action: walk the workspace as in Requirement 5, compare (size, mtime) with the indexed values, treat a file indexed within the previous 2 seconds as changed, and mark changed and new files dirty and files no longer yielded dirty and gone
criteria.contract: A same-size edit made through execute within the 2 s window is returned

setup: an index built moments ago over a fixture
a file edited with a same-size, same-second replacement through execute
a file deleted and a file created through execute
check.pseudocode: cs(); execute("sed -i s/aaaa/bbbb/ f.txt; rm gone.txt; echo x > n.txt"); r=cs('bbbb'); assert 'f.txt' in paths(r); assert 'gone.txt' not in paths(cs('goneToken'))

criteria.condition: a dirty path is not in the index, or the changed file has the base name .gitignore
criteria.action: run a revalidation walk before answering, because only the walk's ignore engine can say whether a new file is visible
criteria.contract: a revalidation walk runs for the unknown path before answering; a newly ignored file is no longer returned; a file newly visible after a .gitignore edit is returned; a known non-.gitignore path does not cause a walk

setup: a built index with a revalidation counter
a new file written to a directory ignored by a new .gitignore rule
check.pseudocode: write_file(unknown.go); cs(); assert revals==1; write_file(known.go); cs(); assert revals==1; write_file('.gitignore','a.go\n'); cs(); assert revals==2; assert 'a.go' not in paths(r)

criteria.action: search the still-visible dirty files with the same zoekt engine and the same parsed query through an overlay shard indexed with symbols from outline and rebuilt only when the dirty set changes, merge overlay hits with indexed hits by score rather than appending them, and report dirty_files
criteria.contract: A fresh edit that would score below the max_files cap among indexed hits still appears in the result

setup: a built index with 30 files that all match a query with high scores
one file edited so it matches with a lower score than the others
max_files 10
check.pseudocode: edit(f); r=cs(query,max_files=10); assert f in paths(r); assert isSortedByScore(r.files); assert r.Data.dirty_files==1; cs(); assert overlayBuilds==1

criteria.condition: more than 5% of the indexed files are dirty
criteria.action: rebuild the whole index under the bounds of Requirement 5 instead of using an overlay, swap the new index in only when it is ready, close and delete the old shards after the swap, and make queries arriving meanwhile wait abandonably and use the new index
criteria.contract: At 4% dirty the build counter is unchanged and at 6% it increases by 1

setup: a built index of 100 files with a build counter
old shards recorded before the swap
a rebuild blocked by a blocking fake Runner
two concurrent queries, one with a context that will end
check.pseudocode:
invalidate 4; cs(); assert builds==1; invalidate 2 more; cs(); assert builds==2; assert !exists(oldShard)
startRebuildBlocked(); go q1(ctxCancel); cancel(); assert q1.Code=='aborted' && buildStillBlocked(); release(); assert q2 sees newContent

criteria.action: give every dirty mark a generation number so that a build or revalidation pass clears only marks older than the pass, keeping a mark made while it runs
criteria.contract: the mark made during the pass survives the pass because its generation is newer; the following query shows the new content of the concurrently written file; marks older than the pass are cleared

setup: a blocking fake Runner holding a build or revalidation open
a concurrent write_file to an indexed file made during the block
check.pseudocode: go cs(); waitBlocked(); write_file(a.go,'midBuildToken'); release(); r=cs('midBuildToken'); assert 'a.go' in paths(r)

criteria.condition: no Invalidate call has been made (a read-only phase)
criteria.action: build once and never run a revalidation walk or rebuild
criteria.contract: the build counter stays 1; the revalidation walk counter stays 0

setup: a built index, a revalidation counter and a build counter
check.pseudocode: for i in 1..20: cs(); assert builds==1 && revals==0

criteria.action: for any sequence of write_file, edit_file and shell calls made through AgentKit's tools followed by a code_search, never show file content older than the last such call
criteria.contract: the result contains the latest content of every file touched; no result line contains content that has been overwritten or deleted; a deleted file appears in no result

setup: a fixture workspace with a built index and tools.All wired to it
a model of file contents tracked in memory
check.pseudocode: for seq in gen_ops(): apply(seq,model); for f in touched: r=cs(token(f)); assert content(r,f) subset model[f]; assert deleted not in paths(r)

requirements.title: find_symbol through the index
requirements.rationale: When the index is already built, find_symbol can answer from its data with an identical contract, and falls back otherwise.

criteria.action: answer from the per-file outline.File data collected by the build rather than from a zoekt query, using the smart-case prefix, exact, qualified-name, kind and path matching of 02_symbol_navigation_tools Requirement 2, leaving ranking and truncation to find_symbol
criteria.contract: lowercase queries match case-insensitively by prefix and mixed-case queries match case-sensitively; exact requires full-name equality; qualified names match Container.Name; kind and path filters restrict the matches; no zoekt query is issued; matches are unranked and untruncated beyond the 1000 limit

setup: an index built from fixture outline data with declarations Runner, runner, Server.Run, and directories a/ and b/
check.pseudocode: a,ok=Symbols(ctx,SymbolQuery{Name:'run'}); assert ok; assert names(a.Matches)==expected; assert zoektQueries==0

criteria.condition: an earlier code_search has built the index and it is neither partial nor closed and the matches number at most 1 000
criteria.action: return ok=true with the matches and SymbolAnswer.FilesIndexed
criteria.contract: Returns (SymbolAnswer, true, nil); find_symbol's header names the index as its backend

setup: a code_search has built a complete, non-closed index
check.pseudocode: cs(); a,ok,err=idx.Symbols(ctx,q); assert ok && err==nil && a.FilesIndexed==N; assert contains(find_symbol(q).Text,'index')

criteria.condition: the index is not yet built, is partial, is closed, or the matches number more than 1 000
criteria.action: return no answer so that find_symbol uses its own table as if no index were set
criteria.contract: Returns ok=false with a nil error; Symbols starts no build

setup: an unbuilt index, a partial index, a closed index, and an index with 1001 matching declarations
check.pseudocode: for idx in [unbuilt,partial,closed,big]: _,ok,err=idx.Symbols(ctx,q); assert !ok && err==nil; assert builds unchanged

criteria.condition: Symbols is called while dirty files are in scope or a revalidation is pending
criteria.action: run the pending revalidation and re-outline the dirty files in scope under the dirty-path rules of Requirement 6 before answering
criteria.contract: Fresh is found; the renamed declaration appears under its new path and not the old; the revalidation walk ran once

setup: a built index
a file edited through write_file to add func Fresh
a pending Invalidate("") after a shell rename
check.pseudocode: write_file(a.go,'func Fresh(){}'); a,ok,_=Symbols({Name:'Fresh'}); assert ok && len(a.Matches)==1; execute('mv x.go y.go'); a,_,_=Symbols(...); assert path(a.Matches[0])=='y.go'

criteria.condition: the context passed to Symbols is cancelled
criteria.action: stop and return the context error, this being the only use of the error return
criteria.contract: Returns a non-nil error; no other condition returns an error

setup: a built index
a context cancelled before the call, and a dirty file making work necessary
check.pseudocode: _,_,err=Symbols(cancelled,q); assert err!=nil; for s in states: _,_,err=Symbols(live,q); assert err==nil

criteria.action: for any fixture tree and query, give find_symbol the same matches in the same order as its own in-memory table over the same tree
criteria.contract: the match lists are identical in content and order; only the header's backend line may differ

setup: a generated fixture tree of Go and heuristic-supported files built into an index by a prior code_search
a find_symbol tool with Options.Index set and one with Index nil over the same tree
check.pseudocode: for tree,q in gen(): idx=build(tree); a=findSymbol(withIdx,q); b=findSymbol(noIdx,q); assert a.Matches==b.Matches

requirements.title: Concurrency, lifetime and platform support
requirements.rationale: The embedder owns the index lifetime, so locking, Close and the Windows fallback must be unambiguous.

criteria.action: guard index state with one lock and run queries concurrently with each other under a read lock, with no data race under `go test -race`
criteria.contract: all calls return successful results; the race detector reports nothing

setup: a built index, tests run with -race
check.pseudocode: wg; for i in 1..32: go cs(); go Symbols(); go Invalidate('a.go'); wg.Wait(); // go test -race

criteria.condition: a call waiting behind a build or rebuild has its context end
criteria.action: abandon the wait
criteria.contract: ErrResult code aborted returned without waiting for the build to finish

criteria.condition: Close is called
criteria.action: wait for in-flight queries, release the zoekt searcher and delete the run directory, and do the same nothing on every later call
criteria.contract: Close returns nil each time; the run directory no longer exists after the first call

setup: a built index with a query blocked in flight through a test seam
check.pseudocode: go inflight(); done=go Close(); assert !done.finished; release(); assert done.err==nil; assert !exists(runDir); assert Close()==nil; assert Close()==nil

criteria.condition: a tool is called or Symbols is called after Close
criteria.action: refuse without building or searching
criteria.contract: Tools return ErrResult code index_closed; Symbols returns ok=false

setup: a closed index with a build counter and a search counter
check.pseudocode: idx.Close(); r=cs(); assert r.Code=='index_closed'; _,ok,_=Symbols(); assert !ok; assert builds==before && searches==before

criteria.action: return no closer, leave Close to the embedder, and rely on a later run's 24-hour sweep to remove a run directory abandoned without Close
criteria.contract: All returns only ([]core.Tool, error) with no closer; the abandoned directory is removed by the later build's sweep

setup: tools.All signature
an index never closed whose run directory is aged 25 hours
check.pseudocode: assert returns(All)==([]core.Tool,error); age(dir,25h); build(other); assert !exists(dir)

criteria.condition: the pinned zoekt does not build or run on windows/amd64
criteria.action: provide, in a file constrained to that platform, codesearch.New returning the exported ErrUnsupported while the module still builds there, with ErrUnsupported the same error value on every platform
criteria.contract: errors.Is(err, codesearch.ErrUnsupported) is true; an embedder falls back to Options.Index == nil

setup: a windows-constrained file providing New that returns ErrUnsupported (only if the pinned zoekt does not build on windows)
check.pseudocode: _,err=New(ws,Options{}); assert errors.Is(err,ErrUnsupported); assert run('go build ./...',GOOS=windows).ok

criteria.action: build and vet on linux/amd64, linux/arm64, darwin/arm64 and windows/amd64 with CGO_ENABLED=0 and contain no cgo file anywhere in its dependency graph
criteria.contract: all eight commands succeed; the test lives in codesearch/policy_test.go

setup: codesearch/ with the pinned zoekt
check.pseudocode: for t in targets: assert run('go build ./...',CGO_ENABLED=0,t).ok; assert run('go vet ./...',CGO_ENABLED=0,t).ok

requirements.title: Risks settled before any code
requirements.rationale: The unverified zoekt assumptions decide whether the spec can proceed, so they are checked first and a failure ends the spec instead of being worked around.

criteria.action: pin a zoekt release and record in codesearch/README.md and in the spec's external API notes, against that release: the module path and the packages for the index builder, query parser and searcher; whether a shard can be searched from memory or only from a file; the builder's per-document symbol fields as byte offsets; the search options bounding result size and wall time; the `go list -m all` output; and the build and vet results for the four targets

criteria.condition: a cgo file exists anywhere in the dependency graph under CGO_ENABLED=1
criteria.action: end the spec as a no-go instead of working around it
criteria.contract: No code is merged; the evidence is recorded in the PRD

setup: CGO_ENABLED=1
a probe package with a cgo file
check.pseudocode: env CGO_ENABLED=1; assert noCgo(list('./...')); assert detects(probe)

criteria.condition: a package of the codesearch module directly imports a package that pulls in gRPC, Prometheus or an HTTP server beyond zoekt's indexing, query and search packages
criteria.action: end the spec as a no-go instead of loosening the forbidden-import list; the packages zoekt's indexing, query and search packages themselves import (gRPC, Prometheus, sentry) are accepted, per docs/errata/03_forbidden_imports_direct_only.md
criteria.contract: No code is merged; the evidence is recorded in the PRD

setup: the direct imports of every package of the codesearch module
a synthetic import list containing google.golang.org/grpc
check.pseudocode: assert forbidden(directImportsOf('./...'))==[]; assert 'grpc' in forbidden(synthetic)

criteria.condition: the zoekt builder cannot accept symbol data from outside
criteria.action: end the spec as a no-go, because accepting it would force zoekt's own ctags process
criteria.contract: No code is merged; the evidence is recorded in the PRD

setup: a zoekt builder with CTagsPath empty
a document with a symbol section supplied as byte offsets
check.pseudocode: doc={Name,Content,Symbols:[{Start,End}],SymbolsMetaData}; build; r=search('sym:Foo'); assert r.Files[0].Name==docWithSymbol; assert spawns==0

criteria.condition: zoekt fails to build or run on windows/amd64
criteria.action: treat it as the ErrUnsupported stub of Requirement 8 and not as a no-go
criteria.contract: The spec continues; the module still builds on windows/amd64

requirements.title: Tests, build wiring and documentation
requirements.rationale: The nested module is invisible to the root policy tests and the Makefile, so the same guarantees and docs must be added explicitly.

criteria.action: contain its own TestNoCgoOutsideStdlib and TestCgoProbeIsArmed run with CGO_ENABLED=1, a forbidden-import check over codesearch's direct imports for gRPC, Prometheus and HTTP servers (the transitive graph of zoekt's packages is accepted, per docs/errata/03_forbidden_imports_direct_only.md), a build and vet of the four targets, and, where the stub is used, a test asserting ErrUnsupported
pass unmodified after this spec lands
run test, vet, lint and tidy over codesearch/ as well as the root and difftest, and make `make check` pass both with and without universal-ctags installed
criteria.contract: each target includes codesearch alongside the root and difftest; make check exits 0 in both environments

setup: the Makefile
an environment with universal-ctags and one with it removed from PATH
check.pseudocode: for t in [test,vet,lint,tidy]: assert 'codesearch' in dryrun(t); assert run('make check').code==0 with ctags; assert run('make check',PATH=noctags).code==0

criteria.action: obtain symbols in every test through a fake Runner or DisableCtags, skip a test that uses real universal-ctags when it is absent, and run seam tests with Options.Index set to a fake tools.Index
criteria.contract: no test constructs an index with the default runner without DisableCtags or a fake; tests using real ctags call a skip when exec.LookPath fails; go test passes without ctags; seam tests set Options.Index to a fake tools.Index

setup: the codesearch test sources
an environment without universal-ctags
check.pseudocode: for f in testfiles: assert usesFake(f) or usesDisable(f) or hasSkip(f,'LookPath'); assert run('go test ./...',PATH=noctags).ok

criteria.action: describe what the module is, how to opt in with the one-line Options.Index and the allowlist entry, the Requirement 9 answers and the known differences from search_files, and say that its goldens are tied to the pinned zoekt version

update in the same change docs/architecture.md (module boundary beside difftest/ and examples/flatline, package table and graph rows), docs/DEPS.md (a new numbered ruling for zoekt confined to the nested module and the extended nested-modules sentence), docs/configuration.md (an Index row in the tools.Options table, the code_search limits and the codesearch.Options fields), docs/cli.md (the changed make target descriptions) and the root README.md module list
criteria.contract: architecture.md shows the module boundary beside difftest/ and examples/flatline plus package table and graph rows for codesearch; DEPS.md has a new numbered ruling for zoekt confined to the nested module and an extended nested-modules sentence; configuration.md has an Index row in the tools.Options table, the code_search limits and the codesearch.Options fields; cli.md describes the changed make targets; README.md lists the codesearch module
